This '''spaceport''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zelos II]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[T'Charek Haathi]] and her [[T'Charek Haathi's Special Ops team|Special Ops team]] stole a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], [[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''The Maker'']] from the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].
